title: Release step: notify opum-marketplace of every new tag so it re-resolves the federated skills/ baseline
description:
opum-marketplace landed scripts/check-federated-content.mjs plus scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json (their PR #70). That check resolves the federation chain live — tag ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> skills subtree — and fails when the resolved skills/ SHA does not match the recorded baseline. Today's baseline for opum-lore is 24277e9a94d6cc9b5a8c7fa12fa32c4f15eb4c0f (opum-quest is 633c776b).

CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS REPO: when lore-cli cuts a new tag whose skills/ content differs, opum-marketplace's pin bump must carry the re-resolved skills/ SHA in the SAME change, or their check goes red. Re-tagging over byte-identical skills/ content still passes untouched, so a re-point that does not change the skill is a marketplace no-op.

Their check also runs on a daily schedule and on pushes to their dev/main — not only when marketplace.json changes — because a tag can move without their repo changing at all. So a red check there can surface with no action on their side.

HANDSHAKE: opum-marketplace offered to re-verify and update their baseline if this repo tells them the tag at cut time, rather than us discovering it as a red check downstream. Take them up on it — message the live opum-marketplace session with the tag name, the tag object SHA, the commit it peels to, and the resolved skills/ tree SHA.

NOT DONE YET, and the reason: this step belongs in docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md's release checklist, next to the existing version-bump / bin.lore-flip / tag / dispatch sequence. That edit is blocked until LCLI-468 reconciles this checkout onto the rebuilt origin history — editing docs now would mean committing on the pre-purge history. Do the docs change after LCLI-468, driven through lore per CLAUDE.md, with lore check exiting 0 as the definition of done.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md release checklist names the step: notify opum-marketplace with the new tag and the resolved skills/ tree SHA
The runbook states the passing case explicitly — re-tagging over byte-identical skills/ content needs no marketplace change

The concrete coupled files are named in the runbook (opum-marketplace scripts/check-federated-content.mjs and scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json), per the cross-repo-dependency rule that an unnamed concrete file is invisible to whoever deletes it
